latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with automated daily learning card generation and dual-channel support.

- Automatically extracts and summarizes learning content from Feishu and WebUI chat records.
- Merges and filters multi-session data; generates structured learning cards with topics, decisions, pitfalls, concepts, and insights.
- Supports user configuration for extraction rules, output formats, and scheduling via JSON file.
- Includes standalone scripts for extraction, AI-powered structuring, and scheduled/one-click execution.
- Externalized prompts and templates for customization.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for regular automated delivery to designated channels.
